fallback.title: Something Went Wrong
fallback.action: Try again. If the problem persists, restart the app.

kupoUnavailableCoded.title: Kupo Unavailable
kupoUnavailableCoded.message: The UTxO indexer is starting up or unreachable.
kupoUnavailableCoded.action: Wait for the node to finish syncing, then try again.

kupoUnavailable.title: Kupo Unavailable
kupoUnavailable.message: The UTxO indexer is not responding.
kupoUnavailable.action: Wait for the node to finish syncing, or check Settings for process status.

ogmiosPostTimeout.title: Ogmios Request Timed Out
ogmiosPostTimeout.message: The transaction service did not respond in time. The node connection may be degraded.
ogmiosPostTimeout.action: Try restarting the node from Settings, or wait for the node to fully sync.

ogmiosConnectFailed.title: Cannot Reach Ogmios
ogmiosConnectFailed.message: The transaction service is not reachable on its expected port.
ogmiosConnectFailed.action: Ensure the node is running, or restart from Settings.

ogmiosUnavailable.title: Ogmios Unavailable
ogmiosUnavailable.message: The transaction submission service is not responding.
ogmiosUnavailable.action: Wait for the node to finish syncing, or check Settings for process status.

network.title: Network Error
network.message: Could not connect to the required service.
network.action: Check your internet connection and ensure the node is running.

noCollateral.title: No Collateral
noCollateral.message: Your wallet needs a dedicated 5 ADA collateral UTxO for smart contract transactions.
noCollateral.action: Go to Settings > Wallet and click "Set Collateral".

collateralFundsInsufficient.title: Insufficient Funds for Collateral
collateralFundsInsufficient.message: Your wallet does not have enough ADA to create a collateral UTxO.
collateralFundsInsufficient.action: Send at least 10 ADA to your wallet address.

collateralInsufficient.title: Insufficient Collateral
collateralInsufficient.message: The transaction requires more collateral than is available.
collateralInsufficient.action: Ensure your wallet has a UTxO set as collateral. Try refreshing your wallet balance.

insufficientBalance.title: Insufficient Balance
insufficientBalance.message: Your wallet does not have enough ADA for this transaction.
insufficientBalance.action: Add more ADA to your wallet and try again.

iagonAuth.title: Iagon Authentication Failed
iagonAuth.message: Your Iagon API key is invalid or expired.
iagonAuth.action: Go to Settings → Data Layer and re-authenticate.

iagonFileTooLarge.title: File Too Large for Iagon
iagonFileTooLarge.message: Iagon does not support uploading files this large.

iagonQuota.title: Iagon Storage Full
iagonQuota.message: Your Iagon account storage quota is full.
iagonQuota.action: Check your Iagon account storage usage.

iagonGeneric.title: Storage Service Error
iagonGeneric.message: Could not reach the Iagon decentralized storage service.
iagonGeneric.action: Check your internet connection. Iagon may be temporarily unavailable.

timeout.title: Request Timed Out
timeout.message: The operation took too long to complete.
timeout.action: Try again. If the problem persists, the service may be under heavy load.

mnemonicChecksum.title: Invalid Recovery Phrase
mnemonicChecksum.message: The recovery phrase has an invalid checksum. One or more words may be incorrect.
mnemonicChecksum.action: Double-check each word against your written backup and try again.

passwordTooShort.title: Password Too Short
passwordTooShort.message: The password must be at least 12 characters long.
passwordTooShort.action: Choose a longer password that meets all the requirements shown.

walletGeneric.title: Wallet Error
walletGeneric.message: There was a problem with the wallet operation.
walletGeneric.action: Try unlocking your wallet again. If the issue persists, restart the app.

incorrectPassword.title: Incorrect Password
incorrectPassword.message: The password you entered is incorrect.
incorrectPassword.action: Double-check your password and try again.

snarkOom.title: Not Enough Memory
snarkOom.message: The proof generation ran out of memory.
snarkOom.action: Close other applications to free memory and try again.

snarkSetupMissing.title: SNARK Setup Files Missing
snarkSetupMissing.message: Required SNARK setup files could not be found.
snarkSetupMissing.action: Go to Settings to re-download the SNARK setup files.

snarkInProgress.title: Proof Already Running
snarkInProgress.message: A zero-knowledge proof is already being generated.
snarkInProgress.action: Wait for the current proof to finish before starting another.

snarkGeneric.title: Proof Generation Error
snarkGeneric.message: The SNARK prover encountered an error.
snarkGeneric.action: Try again. If the problem persists, check that setup files are properly installed.

scriptValidation.title: Script Validation Failed
scriptValidation.message: A smart contract script failed during validation.
scriptValidation.action: The on-chain state may have changed. Refresh and try again.

txConflict.title: Transaction Conflict
txConflict.message: One or more inputs have already been spent by another transaction.
txConflict.action: Someone else may have acted on this listing. Refresh the page and try again.

feeError.title: Transaction Fee Error
feeError.message: The transaction fee was calculated too low.
feeError.action: Try again. If the issue persists, restart the app to refresh fee parameters.

txFailed.title: Transaction Failed
txFailed.message: The transaction could not be submitted to the blockchain.
txFailed.action: The on-chain state may have changed. Refresh and try again.

accessDenied.title: Access Denied
accessDenied.message: The request was blocked by the server.
accessDenied.action: This may be a configuration issue. Try restarting the app.

diskFull.title: Disk Full
diskFull.message: There is not enough disk space to complete this operation.
diskFull.action: Free up disk space and try again. Check Settings > Storage for cleanup options.

portConflict.title: Port Conflict
portConflict.message: A required port is already in use by another process.
portConflict.action: Close other applications that may be using the port, or restart the app.
